prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1032; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. The reported mechanism is consistent with the low-speed lateral impact and with the lumbar strain diagnosed at intake. Over the course of eight visits, treatment included manual therapy, guided stretching, and a graded return-to-activity program. Care extended somewhat beyond what is typical for an uncomplicated strain of this type, with the patient's recovery progressing gradually. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the lumbar region. The patient reports no prior symptoms or treatment involving the same area of the back. Billing records reflect single entries for each visit and procedure, with no duplicate or repeated charges. At the most recent visit, the patient reported improved mobility and reduced pain, and a plan for discharge with home exercises was documented.
